title: Staff Software Engineer - Customer Facing Applied AI
description:
Who We Are

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

The Role

The Applied AI team works embedded with Addepar's strategic clients to figure out where AI can change how they work and then build those capabilities from scratch. You'll spend time understanding a client's world, identify what's worth building, prototype it, prove it works, and then partner with core engineering teams to ship it as product for all customers.

As an Applied AI Engineer, you'll build agentic systems from idea through production. The work starts with understanding the problem well enough to know what to build, then moves fast through prototyping and iteration. You'll design agent behavior, wire up tool integrations, tune evaluations until the AI actually works in practice. You'll sit close to the people who use what you build, and that feedback loop is how both the product and your skills grow fast. The team is new. Your work shapes what we ship.

We onboard hundreds of new customers every month across multiple products. description:

• You have demonstrable experience in Supply Chain Operations, ideally in a similar industry

• You are incredibly resilient and operate well under pressure

• You think on your feet and find quick and efficient solutions to resolve problems with minimal impact to internal and external stakeholders

• You are a self-starter with initiative and a proactive attitude

• You are not afraid to challenge the status-quo with new ideas

• You are a confident decision-maker

• You have great communication skills

• You find the perfect balance between bigger picture thinking and digging for the detail

• You embrace change

• You are a role model that excites and motivates other team members with your passion for success

• You are hungry to learn new things every day

• Skilled in excel and data manipulation

 

What we offer:

• 70% off HelloFresh + free shipping

• Company Pension (matched 1:1 contributions up to 5%)

• Health insurance

• Annual Gym membership or Wellness benefit

• Membership to global leading mindfulness App - Headspace

title: Design Engineer
description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for an outstanding engineer with a real passion for design.

Nubank's design and research function is roughly 260 people. Over the past year they have been building their own tooling: something like 100 AI-assisted solutions and 30+ local knowledge repositories, each built inside a business unit to solve that unit's problem. Most of them work. None of them talk to each other.

The Design Center of Excellence exists to turn that kind of local invention into systems the whole function can build on. It has design ops and research ops. It does not have an engineer - which means the CoE can identify a need, specify a tool, and then has no one to build it.

This is that hire: the first engineer in the CoE, and the person who architects the systems that let design at Nubank scale. You'll work directly with the designers and researchers who use what you build, and the person who scopes a system is the person who builds it.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

NuBrain - the first priority. A global knowledge system for the design and research function, consolidating the 30+ local repositories that already exist. The hard part is not merging content; it's the context architecture - how retrieval is structured, how token consumption stays sane, and how content reaches people and agents at the moment it's useful.

A design quality measurement platform. The function knows what good looks like and has the parameters written down; scoring a flow against them is currently a manual exercise in Figma. The goal is an index - a real number for the quality of a given experience - produced by a system, not a spreadsheet.

Canonicalizing what already exists. Roughly 100 AI solutions have been built locally by designers and researchers. Someone needs to understand what they are, decide what becomes standard for the function, and retire the rest before the duplication compounds.

Deciding the shape of the answer. Plugin, MCP server, agent, Claude skill, or a full platform - that call is yours to make and defend. Part of the job is telling the CoE that the tool they asked for should be something else.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Architect and build the systems design at Nubank runs on - increasingly agentic ones.

- Sit with designers and researchers, understand the need underneath the request, and turn it into something scoped and buildable.

- Stand up or reuse the infrastructure, write the code, and ship it to the function.

- Instrument what you build. Metrics and observability are part of the deliverable, not a follow-up.

- Own the roadmap for CoE tooling: prioritize, sequence, say no, and keep things moving without a PM behind you.

- Be the technical voice in a design organization - make trade-offs legible to people who don't read code.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

An outstanding, deeply experienced engineer. This is an engineering hire first. You've spent years building systems other people build on.

A track record architecting UX systems. Before AI, you designed and built the foundations of user experience at scale - design systems, component platforms, UI frameworks, front-end infrastructure used by many teams.

A love for design that shows up in your work. Since AI, you've used it to build compelling examples and more sophisticated systems than were possible before. We'd like to see them.

title: Senior Software Engineer, SLAM/VIO
description:
About Rivet
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems - fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking - for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. From technicians and engineers to first responders and service members, they embody the hard work, ingenuity, and meritocratic values that drive Western prosperity. Yet too often they are forced to rely on outdated tools that fail under modern pressures. Rivet exists to reset that priority.

At Rivet, you’ll join a mission-driven team that fuses disciplines to deliver decisive outcomes where they matter most. Whether shaping our technology, strengthening our partnerships, or building our culture, every role here contributes to equipping the front lines with the modern systems they deserve.

Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

We are building the perception stack that enables robust three/six degrees of freedom tracking, localization, and mapping in complex real-world environments. This role focuses on fusing data from cameras and inertial sensors to power SLAM / Visual-Inertial Odometry pipelines. We need an experienced perception software engineer who can create algorithms and systems that run in real time, handle uncertainty gracefully, and provide the foundation for advanced spatial intelligence on edge devices.

 

Responsibilities

- Develop and optimize sensor fusion algorithms combining IMU and camera data for SLAM and VIO (Simultaneous Localization and Mapping & Visual Inertial Odometry)

- Implement state of the art structure-from-motion techniques using different sensor modalities to generate consistent 3D reconstructions

- Evaluate algos against public benchmarks and real-world datasets

- Integrate outputs into higher-level autonomy or collaborative mapping systems (i.e. shared mapping systems)

- Collaborate with HW, robotics and platform teams to ensure end-to-end performance

- Define metrics, testing frameworks and deployment strategies for production-ready perception systems

Requirements

- BS with 10+ years of academic or industry experience in inertial sensing, computer vision, robotics or related fields with shipped or published work (or MS with 8+ yrs of the above)

- Shipped SLAM/VIO features to product

- Strong background in linear algebra, 3D geometry, VIO (probabilistic filtering and/or factor-graph optimization), and visual mapping (incremental mapping, submaps, loop closure)

- Proficient in C++/Python with experience in real-time optimization

- Proficient in using and debugging geometric optimization frameworks (e.g. Ceres, GTSAM, g2o)

- Knowledge of sensor modelling, calibration and noise characteristics

- Experience with real-time processing pipelines on embedded or edge hardware

- Preferred track record of applied research in robotics or AR/VR

 

Compensation may vary within the posted range based on relevant experience, skills, education, and other job-related factors. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for equity and other forms of compensation. Eligible employees also receive a competitive benefits package, including unlimited PTO.

Rivet is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Certain roles may require U.S. Person status, security clearance eligibility, or other requirements imposed by law or government contract.

Echte Flexibilität : Ob Workation mit Freund:innen oder Kolleg:innen, morgendliches Yoga oder eine Sport-Session mittags - bei uns kannst du Arbeit und Privatleben easy miteinander verbinden.

Onboarding : Du startest nicht mit leeren Händen, sondern bekommst top Hardware, alles was du zum Arbeiten brauchst, und kannst dir im Welcome Shop coole Produkte von unseren Partnern & Friends aussuchen.

•
Du weißt nicht weiter? Wir unterstützen dich mit unseren Weiterbildungsangeboten und individuellen Development Budgets! Und wenns nicht ums Berufliche geht, kannst du deinen Zugang zur Gesundheitsplattform nilo.health nutzen, um dir den Support zu holen, den du brauchst.

Wir kleiden dich ein : Noch keine Produkte der SNOCKS -Group in deinem Kleiderschrank? Das ändern wir! Du erhältst jedes Jahr einen 360€ Gutschein von uns sowie weitere tolle Rabatte und Angebote wie bspw. Corporate Benefits.

The SME will help ensure our proposed technical, staffing, management, and quality-control approaches reflect how this work is performed in the field.
Responsibilities

• Review the Performance Work Statement and related solicitation documents to identify operational requirements, risks, dependencies, and performance expectations.

• Advise the proposal team on ARNG recruiting, retention, accession, and Reserve Component transition processes.

• Explain the roles and working relationships among ARNG G1 organizations, Reserve Component Career Counselors, Transition Counselors, Recruiting and Retention Battalions, Interstate Transfer and In-Service Recruiting personnel, and gaining units.

• Help develop an operational approach for the Guard Strength Enhancement Program and Active Component-to-Reserve Component transitions.

• Provide insight into counseling Soldiers on ARNG and USAR opportunities, eligibility, benefits, incentives, entitlements, vacancies, assignments, and continued-service options.

• Advise on the preparation, review, quality control, approval, and tracking of accession and transition packets.

• Provide practical knowledge of relevant systems, including RETAIN, IPPS-A, iPERMS, MEDPROS, DPRO, AUVS, and related Army personnel systems.

• Help identify appropriate labor categories, qualifications, staffing levels, workload assumptions, and organizational relationships.

• Review proposed workflows for transition counseling, help desk support, system-access requests, production reporting, Soldier tracking, and issue resolution.

• Assist in developing realistic performance metrics and quality-control methods for counseling, packet processing, accessions, customer support, reporting, and vacancy management.

• Review proposal content for operational accuracy, completeness, and alignment with ARNG and Department of the Army policies and practices.

• Participate in proposal strategy sessions, solution-development meetings, and draft reviews as needed.

Required Qualifications:

• Former Army or Army National Guard service with substantial experience in recruiting, retention, career counseling, military personnel, strength management, or Reserve Component transition operations.

• Direct knowledge of ARNG recruiting and retention processes and the accession of Soldiers into Army National Guard units.

• Experience supporting Soldiers transitioning from the Active Component, Army Reserve, or Individual Ready Reserve.

Peraton is seeking an experienced Software Quality Assurance Engineer to independently execute and take expanded ownership of quality assurance and test automation activities on the BASIS program. Test Automation Development & Strategy

title: Threat Detection & Response Engineer, AI-Era Detection & Response
description:
TrendAI™, the global AI security leader and enterprise business unit of Trend Micro , empowers organizations with full AI visibility and consolidated security that inspires confidence, drives innovation, and eliminates risk.

At TrendAI™, we’re always seeking exceptional talent; people who want to collaborate with the best and push boundaries together. Here, your work goes beyond building a career. You will help protect what matters and play a vital role in shaping a safer, more trustworthy AI-powered future.
AI Fearlessly.
About the Team

Our Security Research & Development group sits at the frontier of AI-era cyber defense. We study how attackers are beginning to weaponize artificial intelligence, how AI is reshaping detection and response, and what durable capabilities defenders will need over the next several years. We are not a day-to-day operations team. Our charter is to research, prototype, and design the core capabilities that will anchor our platform and our customers' defenses for the next generation.
The Role

We are seeking a Threat Detection & Response Engineer to help research AI-era threats and defensive technologies and to build the detection-and-response capabilities that strengthen our platform. This is a mid-level individual-contributor role that combines threat research with hands-on engineering.
Working closely with senior architects and researchers, you will investigate emerging threats, build and test prototypes, and help turn promising research into production-ready capabilities. You will collaborate across threat intelligence, detection engineering, and AI/ML teams to translate findings into practical detection and response improvements. This role is an excellent path for an engineer looking to grow toward senior and principal-level threat architecture.
Key Responsibilities

• Threat & technology research. Investigate emerging AI-era threats - including AI-enabled attacks and threats to AI systems (e.g., prompt injection, model misuse) - and summarize findings for the team.

• Detection engineering. Build, test, and refine detection-and-response capabilities that integrate with existing security tooling and analyst workflows, under the guidance of senior architects.

• Prototyping & experimentation. Develop and evaluate prototypes to test the feasibility of new defensive approaches; help document them into clear specifications.

• Collaboration. Partner with detection engineering, data science, and platform teams to move prototypes toward production-ready capabilities.

• Communication. Communicate research findings and technical work clearly to teammates and stakeholders.

Minimum Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.

• 3+ years in cybersecurity, software engineering, or a related technical field, with exposure to threat detection and response.

• Experience building or contributing to technical systems that reached production.

• Familiarity with security tooling and operational workflows, and an interest in how they integrate.

• Basic familiarity with AI/ML concepts and their application to threat detection, and awareness of frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK.

• Proficiency in at least one programming language (e.g., Python).

• Strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

• Master's degree in computer science, machine learning, or a security-related discipline, or equivalent experience.

• Exposure to AI/ML security concepts, such as adversarial ML or defending against AI-enabled attacks (e.g., awareness of the OWASP Top 10 for LLMs).

• Hands-on experience with detection-and-response tooling (EDR / XDR, SIEM, or SOAR).

• Experience working with data-processing systems or cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).

• A relevant security certification (e.g., Security+, GCIH, OSCP) or equivalent demonstrated skill.

OpenAI's Legal team plays a crucial role in furthering OpenAI's mission by tackling innovative, fundamental legal issues in AI. If you're passionate about doing significant and unique work as a technology lawyer, this team is for you. The team comprises professionals from diverse fields, including technology, AI, privacy, IP, corporate, employment, tax law, regulatory, and litigation.

As a member of our AI Product Counsel team, you will advise the teams building and deploying OpenAI’s business products, including ChatGPT Business, ChatGPT Enterprise, and our API platform. You will partner closely with Product, Engineering, Safety, Security, Privacy, Strategy, Go-to-Market, and other Legal teams on issues spanning enterprise product development, model launches, customer data protections, administrative controls, strategic partnerships, and the responsible deployment of increasingly capable AI models. This is a unique opportunity to help shape how frontier AI products are built and delivered to businesses.

This role is based in San Francisco, CA. We use a hybrid work model of three days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

- Serve as a strategic legal partner to teams developing ChatGPT’s business products, enterprise features, and API offerings.

- Advise on product design and launches involving enterprise administration, data governance, identity and access, connectors and integrations, agentic capabilities, and voice and multimodal experiences in the B2B space.

- Support strategic partnerships and distribution arrangements, including cloud platforms, resellers, and other third-party channels through which customers access OpenAI models.

- Partner with Commercial Legal, Privacy, Security, Safety, Product and Product Policy, and Go-to-Market teams on customer-facing commitments, product terms, launch readiness, and legal and regulatory requirements.

- Have 8+ years of experience with a mix of in-house or technology-focused law firm roles.

- Build cross-functional relationships and communication styles that resonate with teams to balance risk-taking with responsible development.

description:
About the Role
We are looking for experienced Internal Appointment Setters / SDRs to join a fast-paced, fully remote outbound sales environment.
This is a pure B2B cold-calling role focused on speaking directly with US small and mid-sized business owners and sales leaders. You will be responsible for opening conversations, identifying genuine business needs, handling objections confidently, and booking qualified 30-minute sales meetings.
This position is best suited to someone who already understands the rhythm and discipline of outbound prospecting - including call volume, connect rates, follow-up, meeting conversion and rebooking no-shows.
Requirements
Key Responsibilities

• Make high-volume outbound cold calls to US-based small and mid-sized businesses.

• Maintain an average calling pace of approximately 20-25 dials per hour .

• Speak directly with business owners, decision-makers and sales leaders.

• Follow a structured cold-calling methodology and sales script.

• Identify whether prospects have a genuine business need and qualify opportunities accordingly.

• Book qualified 30-minute sales meetings and secure them on the calendar.

• Follow up consistently with prospects who request a callback.

• Proactively rebook prospects who no-show rather than treating the opportunity as lost.

• Maintain accurate prospect statuses, notes, follow-ups and meeting information within the CRM.

• Provide a concise end-of-shift update covering calls, conversations, meetings booked and outstanding follow-ups.

• Participate in ongoing sales coaching, call reviews, role-play sessions and team training.

Performance Expectations
The role operates in a measurable, performance-driven environment. The initial benchmark is approximately one booked meeting for every two hours of calling , with performance expected to progress toward approximately one appointment per hour .
Successful candidates should be comfortable discussing and working against metrics such as:

• Daily dial volume

• Connect/conversation rates

• Conversations-to-meeting conversion

• Meeting show rates

• Weekly meetings booked

Essential Experience & Requirements
Candidates must have:

• A minimum of 12 months' experience in a genuine outbound cold-calling role .

• Recent outbound calling experience gained within the last two years .

• Proven B2B sales, appointment-setting or SDR experience .

• Experience cold calling rather than working primarily with warm inbound enquiries.

• Experience selling or prospecting into the US or UK market , or demonstrable ability to communicate effectively with US prospects.

• Strong experience handling objections and maintaining composure during difficult calls.

• A clear, warm, professional and easy-to-understand speaking voice suitable for engaging US business owners.

• Strong knowledge of their own outbound sales metrics and previous performance.

• A persistent but professional approach to follow-up and rebooking.

• The ability to work independently and remain productive throughout a remote evening shift.

• A coachable mindset and willingness to follow an established sales methodology.

Communication Style
We are looking for someone who sounds warm, confident, composed and unhurried on the phone. Strong candidates know how to slow a conversation down, ask effective questions, leave space for the prospect to respond and remain calm when faced with objections or rejection.
The ability to maintain the right tone under objection is particularly important.
Remote Working Requirements
As this is a phone-intensive remote position, candidates must have:

• A quiet, dedicated home working environment with no disruptive background noise.

• Stable and reliable internet, preferably with a wired connection.

• A reliable backup solution for internet or power interruptions.

• A working computer.

• A professional-quality headset.

• A webcam for meetings, training and coaching sessions.

Working Hours
Monday to Friday - Full Time

title: Director, Data Science
description:
Description
Director II, Data Science - AI Information and Intelligence

Position Overview

We are seeking a Director of Data Science to lead the AI Information and Intelligence team within the Global AI Products and Transformation organization in GRS Data Science Solutions. This team owns the reusable AI capabilities that let underwriting and claims systems find, extract, and connect the information those systems need - including intelligent data and document extraction, external research and enrichment, knowledge/guidelines/policy intelligence, evidence intelligence, and “like-me” comparison capabilities.

This leader will build and manage a team of data science managers, data scientists, and AI/ML engineers, and will be accountable for establishing a durable, reusable capability layer that multiple segments and geographies can extend rather than rebuild. They will set technical direction, develop the roadmap for their capability domain, and partner closely with the peer leaders of AI Products and Decisioning and AI Product Strategy and Scale, with segment data science teams, and with Technology to ensure capabilities are built once, proven in a lead segment, and scaled across the enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of data science managers, data scientists, and AI/ML engineers responsible for the Information and Intelligence capability domain.

• Own the roadmap for reusable “find / extract / connect” capabilities - data extraction, external research and enrichment, knowledge/guidelines/forms intelligence, evidence intelligence, and comparable (“like-me”) intelligence - and prioritize investment for maximum reuse and value.

• Direct the design, development, deployment, and ongoing improvement of production-grade AI/ML solutions that prove out in a lead segment and are engineered from the start to extend to other segments and geographies.

• Partner with the leaders of AI Products and Decisioning and AI Product Strategy and Scale to sequence shared/dependent capabilities (e.g., hazard/concern flagging, rules and guideline intelligence, information sufficiency detection) and to hand off mature capabilities for adoption.

• Partner with segment data science teams and Technology leadership to translate lighthouse solutions into enterprise-scale platforms, defining the architecture that gives AI systems governed access to relevant data and context.

• Establish common evaluation, quality, and feedback standards for the capabilities the team owns, and ensure outputs are traceable to source and auditable.

• Set engineering standards across the team’s AI development lifecycle - testing, version control, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and MLOps/AIOps.

• Manage team structure, staffing, and workload across onshore, near-shore, and partner resources, including hiring and performance management for direct reports who themselves manage teams.

• Communicate roadmap, trade-offs, progress, and recommendations clearly to technical teams, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.

Required Qualifications

• Demonstrated experience leading data science or AI/ML teams, including direct people-management of managers and/or senior individual contributors.

• Hands-on background developing and deploying production-grade AI or ML solutions, with advanced knowledge of AI/ML methods, engineering practices, and tools.

• Experience owning a product or capability roadmap and making prioritization trade-offs across multiple stakeholder groups.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder-management skills, including experience partnering with peer leaders, engineering/architecture teams, and business sponsors.

• Relevant insurance or regulated-industry experience is preferred.

• Competencies typically acquired through a Ph.D. degree (in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Actuarial Science, or other scientific field of study) and a minimum of 6 years of relevant experience -

IT Manager (m/f/d)
description:
Über Buena

Buena, finanziert von Google Ventures, macht alles rund um Immobilien so einfach und transparent wie den Kauf eines ETFs. Wir übernehmen Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie digital weiter.

Mit jeder Übernahme wachsen auch unsere Anforderungen an die IT: Neue Mitarbeitende, Geräte und Standorte sollen zuverlässig zusammenarbeiten. Dafür suchen wir eine Person, die unsere IT übernimmt und mit unserem Wachstum weiterentwickelt.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest zunächst die IT unserer Berliner Zentrale. Du sorgst dafür, dass Mitarbeitende arbeitsfähig sind, Zugänge sicher verwaltet werden und Geräte sowie Netzwerk zuverlässig funktionieren.

Gleichzeitig entwickelst du Standards und Abläufe, die auch bei der nächsten Hausverwaltung funktionieren. Mittelfristig begleitest du die IT-Integration unserer Tochterunternehmen und arbeitest dabei eng mit unserem externen IT-Partner zusammen.

Du berichtest direkt an unseren Head of Product. Mit wachsender Verantwortung kannst du dich in die Rolle des Head of IT für die Buena-Gruppe entwickeln.

Was du bei uns machst

- Du hältst unsere IT in Berlin am Laufen. Du unterstützt Kolleginnen und Kollegen vor Ort, löst technische Probleme und betreust unser UniFi-Netzwerk.

- Du verantwortest Google Workspace. Du verwaltest Nutzer, Gruppen, Berechtigungen, Shared Drives und Lizenzen und setzt verlässliche Sicherheitseinstellungen um.

- Du organisierst Ein- und Austritte. Neue Mitarbeitende starten mit eingerichteten Konten und Geräten. Beim Austritt kümmerst du dich um Zugriffsrechte, Datensicherung und die Rücknahme der Hardware.

- Du verwaltest unsere Geräte. Du betreust Laptops und Mobilgeräte mit NinjaOne sowie Apple-Geräte über den Apple Business Manager und die angebundene Geräteverwaltung.

- Du verbesserst wiederkehrende Abläufe. Du erkennst unnötige Handarbeit, automatisierst sinnvolle Schritte und dokumentierst Prozesse so, dass andere damit arbeiten können.

- Du begleitest neue Standorte. Du verschaffst dir einen Überblick über deren IT, planst notwendige Anpassungen und setzt sie gemeinsam mit unserem IT-Partner um. Dafür reist du gelegentlich zu unseren Hausverwaltungen.

Für die Tochterunternehmen liegt dein Schwerpunkt auf Integration, Standards und Zusammenarbeit mit den IT-Partnern. Den täglichen Support vor Ort organisieren wir gemeinsam mit diesen Partnern.

Was du mitbringst

- Du hast mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung in der Systemadministration und kannst eine IT-Umgebung eigenständig betreuen.

- Du kennst Google Workspace gut und hast Erfahrung mit Geräteverwaltung, beispielsweise NinjaOne, Jamf oder Intune.

- Du bist mit macOS, iOS und dem Apple Business Manager vertraut und verfügst über solide Netzwerkgrundkenntnisse, idealerweise mit UniFi.

- Du hast bereits einen IT-Prozess verbessert, eine neue Lösung eingeführt oder eine Systemumstellung begleitet und kannst deinen eigenen Beitrag erklären.

- Du gehst Fehlern systematisch auf den Grund und kannst entscheiden, was zuerst gelöst werden muss.

- Du erklärst technische Themen verständlich und arbeitest verbindlich mit Mitarbeitenden und externen Dienstleistern zusammen.

- Du möchtest vor Ort in Berlin-Prenzlauer Berg arbeiten, bist zu gelegentlichen Reisen bereit und sprichst sehr gut Deutsch sowie gut Englisch.

Eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation ist hilfreich. Einschlägige Praxiserfahrung zählt genauso. Führungserfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung; du solltest Lust haben, mit der Aufgabe zu wachsen und zunehmend übergreifende Verantwortung zu übernehmen.

Was du bei uns bekommst

- Verantwortung für einen Bereich, den du aktiv mitgestaltest.

- Die Perspektive, mit Buena in eine Head-of-IT-Rolle hineinzuwachsen.

- Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Head of Integration und kurze Entscheidungswege.

- Attraktives Gehalt und 500 € „Close-to-Office“-Bonus.

- MacBook und Studio Display.

- 110 € Essenszuschuss und 50 € Fitn

description:
This is a remote position.
Advise an early-stage women's health venture on sensor selection and hardware feasibility for a wearable device, helping the founding team make sound technical decisions before committing to a prototype build.
Organization: Confidential - early-stage women's health venture
Location: Remote, open to candidates across the SWANA region; Palestinian talent is welcome
Role Type: Flexible, part-time advisory contract, initially month-to-month
Reports to: The venture's founders
The opportunity
Our client, an early-stage women's health venture, has a defined concept and written description for a sensor-based wearable and is seeking experienced technical guidance before moving into hardware development. The founders - whose team includes a midwife - will continue to drive the research and day-to-day development themselves; they need an advisor who can stress-test the concept, flag feasibility gaps, and help translate a promising idea into a realistic, buildable hardware specification. This is a flexible, part-time advisory role: discussions, reviews and occasional focused technical contributions, with the possibility of a larger role as the venture and the relationship develop.
About the organization
Our client is an early-stage, founder-funded venture building products for women's health, working on several in parallel. The founding team includes a midwife, which grounds the venture's clinical thinking in direct frontline experience. For the sensor-based wearable at the center of this role, the founders have already worked out a concept and a written description of how it could work, and are now looking for the technical judgement to pressure-test that thinking before resources go into building hardware.
What you will do

• Review the wearable concept and proposed measurement methods, assess technical feasibility, and flag gaps or incorrect assumptions

• Recommend suitable sensors and components, and explain alternative approaches to achieving the required measurements

• Advise on design choices that could make the wearable smaller, simpler, or more effective

• Help translate the concept into clear technical specifications, including small pieces of documentation or other focused technical work when agreed

• Discuss progress, help guide development milestones, and help prioritize useful research or exploratory work

• Explain recommendations and trade-offs clearly to founders who do not have an engineering background

• Identify questions that need deeper specialist input and suggest where to seek that expertise

What you bring

• Practical experience in hardware engineering and sensors, with enough technical depth to provide useful, well-founded advice

• Understanding of sensor selection, component choices, and how sensing hardware fits into a complete device

• Broad awareness of what is involved in building a wearable, and the judgement to recognize when additional specialist input is needed

• Clear communication in English, with the ability to explain technical ideas, discuss assumptions, and collaborate constructively with non-technical founders

• Availability for the agreed advisory hours, with some overlap around European lunchtime or evening

Senior experience is helpful, but earlier-career engineers who can demonstrate strong, directly relevant experience and the ability to advise within their area of expertise are also welcome - there is no fixed requirement for a particular number of years.
Helpful, but not essential

• Experience developing wearables or compact sensor-based devices (transferable experience from other hardware products is also welcome)

• Relevant experience with optical sensing, including infrared or blue light, or with flow, temperature, pressure, or density measurement

• Experience in health technology, or an interest in women's health and the problems the venture is working to address

How the engagement works
Compensation is an hourly rate, with the initial allocation

title: Computational Biology & Bioinformatics Expert - Remote
description:
Job Description: Computational Biology & Bioinformatics Expert (PhD)
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote (Worldwide)
About the Role
We are seeking experienced Computational Biology and Bioinformatics Experts to contribute their scientific expertise to the development and evaluation of next-generation AI systems.
In this role, you will apply your knowledge of computational biology, genomics, and bioinformatics to assess complex scientific workflows, analyze biological datasets, and evaluate AI-generated outputs. Your contributions will help improve the accuracy, reliability, and scientific reasoning capabilities of AI systems.
Key Responsibilities

• Design, evaluate, and critique bioinformatics and computational biology workflows for AI benchmarking initiatives.

• Provide expert insights into genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic data analysis pipelines.

• Assess and optimize pipeline parameters, software configurations, and statistical methods to ensure accuracy and reproducibility.

• Analyze biological datasets, including NGS, RNA-seq, variant analysis, and protein structure data, and provide actionable recommendations.

• Apply domain expertise to support the development and validation of biology-focused AI models and tools.

• Communicate complex scientific concepts clearly to technical and non-technical collaborators, both verbally and in writing.

• Document research findings, methodologies, and best practices to support knowledge sharing and collaboration.

Required Skills and Qualifications

• PhD in Bioinformatics, Computational Biology, Genomics, or a closely related field, or equivalent industry or research experience.

• Professional written and spoken English proficiency (C1 level or higher).

• Hands-on experience analyzing biological datasets, such as NGS, RNA-seq, and genomic variant data.

• Proficiency in Python and/or R for scientific analysis.

• Experience with standard bioinformatics tools such as BLAST, Samtools, GATK, Bioconductor, or Biopython.

• Experience developing reproducible workflows using tools such as Nextflow or Snakemake.

• Familiarity with Linux and command-line environments.

• Strong statistical, quantitative, and analytical reasoning skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication abilities, with the ability to clearly document and explain technical concepts.

• Demonstrated ability to solve complex scientific problems in specialized biological domains.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with AI/ML-assisted biology workflows or benchmarking initiatives.

• Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source bioinformatics software.

• Background in single-cell analysis, structural biology, proteomics, or drug discovery.

title: Senior Product Builder, Field Experience and GTM, Fusus
description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

About the Role

Axon Fusus connects cameras, drones, sensors, and real-time information to help public safety teams understand what’s happening and respond effectively. As our capabilities expand, Sales, Customer Success, and Professional Services need to understand what we offer and what is coming next, explain its value, demonstrate it reliably, and help customers put it to use.

We’re looking for a hands-on product builder to own that field experience. Your responsibility is to make the way we launch, equip, and support our customer-facing teams dependable, and earn their trust through accurate information, useful experiences, and consistent follow-through.

This is an individual contributor role with broad ownership and a strong expectation to create. You’ll work directly with the field, decide which problems matter most, and build solutions using AI, software, and better ways of working. You’ll have a substantial AI budget and room to experiment, with accountability for turning promising ideas into improvements people can depend on.

What You’ll Own

• Understand the field and earn its trust. Spend time with sellers, CSMs, and PSO teams. Observe customer conversations, launch preparation, demos, and deployments. Understand where they struggle, what they distrust, and what would help them work confidently. Stay close enough to see whether your changes make a difference.

• Make launches work for the field. Drive consistent launch definitions and readiness expectations with Product and other owners. Ensure teams understand what is available, whom it serves, what they can promise, and how to explain, demonstrate, and deploy it. Follow through on gaps that leave the field unprepared.

• Publish quarterly roadmap updates. Set and share publication dates in advance each year. Work with Product to publish one deck covering everything available and what is expected over the next two quarters or by year-end. Confirm roadmap inputs with the responsible PMs, distinguish planned work from available capabilities, and explain what has changed since the last update. Keep the latest deck in the field resource.

• Make the product demonstrable. Learn Fusus deeply enough to personally demonstrate its capabilities and explain their value through realistic customer scenarios. Build reliable ways for the field to do the same, including working demo environments, representative data, connected devices and integrations, and repeatable setup and reset workflows. Use AI and automation to simplify preparation and check that demonstrations work. Keep these experiences current as the product changes, and test whether colleagues can successfully use them without your help.

• Build the experience end to end. Own how people find product information, get contextual answers, prepare for customers, run demos, and establish trials. Connect those activities into a coherent experience and take responsibility for the points where it breaks down.

• Personally create solutions. Use AI, automation, APIs, and lightweight software to move from an observed problem to something people can try. Build and evaluate assistants, tools, content, and workflows. Choose the approach based on what helps the field accomplish its work.

• Drive the organizational work. Resolve conflicting information, clarify ownership, and bring teams together to make decisions. Partner with Product, Engineering, and operational owners t
